command: Rat ALDH1L1 has NAD+-dependent aldehyde dehydrogenase activity (GO:0004029) and localizes to mitochondria (GO:0005739). Evaluate these independently, separating ALDH1L1 from mitochondrial ALDH1L2. Examine substrate and NAD+/NADP+ specificity of the intact multidomain enzyme versus isolated domains, and quantitative cofactor assays where available. Examine primary localization, isoforms and possible secondary pools without equating the predominant cytosolic location with exclusivity. Distinguish catalytic promiscuity in vitro from a supported physiological activity.
